title_template: {work_unit_id} — Durable autonomous continuation multi-session steady-state execution
goal: Exercise the canonical WU-117 multi-session state machine across multiple independent continuation sessions so fresh provider truth, fresh WU-108/WU-109 recomputation, one delegated transaction per iteration, mandatory readback and checkpoint supersession are proven under real provider drift rather than only defined as contract semantics.
scope: execute at least two independently identified continuation sessions with monotonically increasing session_sequence and distinct checkpoint identities
at each session start fresh-read canonical main, selected Work Unit, provider-state, lease, branch, pull request and exact-head CI truth and discard all persisted mutation authority
perform no more than one delegated provider mutation per admitted iteration and require fresh provider readback before the next iteration or checkpoint refresh
advance provider truth between sessions and prove an older clean checkpoint is superseded deterministically rather than replayed
exercise at least one clean handoff plus interrupted or provider-readback-pending reconciliation without guessed recovery
record bounded public-safe multi-session execution evidence sufficient for a later Human-by-Exception readiness assessment
forbidden_scope: treat WU-117 policy, checkpoint or handoff records as direct provider mutation authority
reuse prior-session control-loop, execution-admission, registry CAS, CI-success, merge-eligibility or Writer Lease ownership
batch multiple delegated provider mutations into one iteration or skip mandatory readback
replay or silently recover an interrupted or ambiguous provider transaction
broaden reusable materialization, Writer Lease, merge/Issue-close, steady-state, durable-resume or multi-session authority
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime, ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: at least two independent session identities are evidenced with monotonic sequence and distinct checkpoint identities
each session start proves fresh provider truth and discards prior-session authority before any mutation
provider drift between sessions is detected and fresh canonical provider truth deterministically supersedes prior checkpoint state
every delegated mutation is isolated to one transaction per iteration and followed by mandatory fresh provider readback
clean, interrupted and readback-pending continuation paths remain fail-closed and replay-free under execution evidence
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
